iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 57. RISING: Iran nuclear chief rules out ANY enrichment restrictions - "will not come true." JINSA report: Fordow expansion could yield several bombs worth of fuel per month. 440kg 60% uranium location uncertain - possibly Isfahan/Natanz/Fordow. IAEA locked out of bombed facilities. E3 NPT statement March 2026. IAEA gov2026-8 report available. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability 35%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 57. BLOCKADE OPERATIONAL: US declares blockade "fully implemented" - trade "completely halted." 6 merchant vessels turned around. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite blockade - direct challenge. Ship spoofing detected near Strait. IRGC threatens to bomb US warships. Iran FM open to 2nd round talks. Pakistan racing to arrange 2nd round talks this week. VP Vance: "lot of progress made in talks." Saudi pushing to remove blockade. Oil Brent ~$92. Ceasefire deadline Apr 22. Diplomatic window opening. Probability 66%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 57. ESCALATING: Washington talks BEGIN TODAY (Apr 15). Hezbollah leader Qassem rejects direct negotiations as "futile" and "treason." Israel rejects ceasefire ahead of talks, continues strikes extending ground ops. 300+ killed in single-day Israeli strikes (Apr 8). 2,089+ killed total, 1M+ displaced. Ceasefire extension uncertain. Pope demands ceasefire. IDF raising alert levels for possible renewed Iran war. Probability 47%. Rising.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Turkey builds global arms network through ~100 defense agreements. Pushing for larger role in Europe defense. $3B defense investment. Tayfun hypersonic entering serial production. Warns Israel as "Hitler of our time." S-400 saga unresolved. Probability 14%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: Pakistani Defence Minister issuing hostile warnings. 2025 India-Pakistan conflict (Operation Sindoor) precedent remains. CFR survey warns armed conflict likely in 2026. Pakistan also mediating Iran ceasefire talks. Drivers of conflict intact - terrorism from Pakistan. Probability 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 62. RISING: Medvedev nuclear threats expanded to Finland/Sweden - "automatic targets." Russia profiting from Iran war - oil revenues surging billions. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war vs neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Carnegie: belligerent post-war posture. Iran war "strategic windfall" for Russia. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. NPT Review shaping as battleground. Probability 68%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: Xi meets Taiwan opposition KMT chairwoman Cheng Li-wun in Beijing - "absolutely not tolerate" independence. Taiwan tracking rising naval activity. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite US blockade - direct challenge to US. Wang Yi visited Pyongyang - China-NK rail resumed. PLA Type 055 destroyers live-fire drill. Chinese sanctions on Japanese lawmaker over Taiwan. $14B US arms for Taiwan. ISW/AEI updates weekly. Probability 32%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 57. ESCALATING: Kim oversaw new missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer - 2 strategic cruise + 3 anti-ship missiles (Apr 12). Third missile launch in two days (Apr 8). Cluster-bomb warheads tested. ODNI confirms NK ICBM can reach entire US mainland. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. South Korea "most hostile enemy." Wang Yi visit strengthens China-NK axis. Probability 87%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1158+. SUSTAINED: Russia "Easter escalation" over ceasefire - 110+ drones targeting civilians. Orthodox Easter truce agreed but collapsed. Patriot missile shortage concern as systems diverted to Iran theater. Russia regenerating tank force. Russia declares completed liberation of Luhansk. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging. 1.2M Russian casualties estimated. Probability 82%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: SUSTAINED: China-mediated ceasefire talks continue in Urumqi. Mid-level Afghan Taliban delegation sent. Fighting continues worst since Taliban 2021. Mortars killing civilians including children. Pakistan simultaneously mediating Iran ceasefire - "unlikely bridge between US and Iran." Lowy Institute calls it "the other war the world is ignoring." Probability 22%. Stable.
